# namesilo_domain (Data Source)

Reads one domain's registrar state: dates, status, registrar lock, WHOIS privacy, auto-renew, traffic type, email verification, portfolio, forwarding, the delegation, and the contact IDs in the four association roles. It is the read half of the domain's managed attributes, for audits, comparisons, and drift detection in a plan.

`forward_url` and `forward_type` are exposed exactly as the API sends them: `N/A` when forwarding is off. They are not mapped to null, because that would be a guess about a value the API is allowed to return. The association roles the API reports as unset come back null, matching how the `namesilo_domain_contacts` resource stores an unmanaged role.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "namesilo_domain" "example" {
  domain = "example.com"
}

output "expires" {
  value = data.namesilo_domain.example.expires
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) The domain whose registrar state to read, e.g. `example.com`.

### Read-Only

- `auto_renew` (Boolean) Whether auto-renewal is on.
- `contact_ids` (Attributes) The domain's contact associations by role. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--contact_ids))
- `created` (String) The creation date, in the API's YYYY-MM-DD form.
- `email_verification_required` (Boolean) Whether the registrant's email verification is pending.
- `expires` (String) The expiry date, in the API's YYYY-MM-DD form.
- `forward_type` (String) The forwarding type exactly as the API sends it, `N/A` included when forwarding is off.
- `forward_url` (String) The forwarding target exactly as the API sends it, `N/A` included when forwarding is off.
- `id` (String) The domain name. It is inert and makes `tofu state show` readable.
- `locked` (Boolean) Whether the registrar lock is on, protecting the domain from transfers.
- `nameservers` (List of String) The domain's nameservers in the API's position order, lowercased and stripped of one trailing dot, the same normalization the resources apply.
- `portfolio` (String) The portfolio the domain belongs to as the API reports it; an empty string when unset.
- `private` (Boolean) Whether WHOIS privacy (PrivacyGuardian) is on.
- `status` (String) The domain's status as the API reports it, e.g. `active`.
- `traffic_type` (String) The traffic type as the API reports it; an empty string when unset.

<a id="nestedatt--contact_ids"></a>
### Nested Schema for `contact_ids`

Read-Only:

- `administrative` (String) The `contact_id` of the administrative profile, null when unset.
- `billing` (String) The `contact_id` of the billing profile, null when unset.
- `registrant` (String) The `contact_id` of the registrant profile, null when unset.
- `technical` (String) The `contact_id` of the technical profile, null when unset.
